flawed_step: Step 4: After valid minimal-counterexample reductions show only that every vertex has degree at least 3, the needed claim that a triangle-free graph with 3 <= delta(G) <= Delta(G) <= 4 must be 3-colorable is unjustified and false.
counterexample: The Chvatal graph is a triangle-free 4-regular graph with chromatic number 4.
assessment_summary: The standard induction works when a vertex has degree at most 2, but it cannot handle a minimal graph whose degrees are all 3 or 4. Such graphs can genuinely require four colors; the Chvatal graph is one, so the statement is false.
